subject: Acme Data CAIQ: control claim concordance & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmedata.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ handoff & control claim concordance

Hi Jordan / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor evaluation we need a CAIQ-style crosswalk showing Redwood's control claims mapped back to CSA controls, plus representative evidence for a sample of high-risk controls (network segmentation, key management, runtime isolation, tenant segregation). Our legal team would like the package by EOD Tuesday (9/7) if possible.

What we need from you:
- A CAIQ control mapping spreadsheet with columns: CSA ID, Redwood claim, evidence filename/link, owner
- Example artifacts (redacted logs, configuration screenshots, policy snippets) for the selected controls
- An ETA on when Redwood will complete the first pass and who to reach for follow-ups

We can share a joint Drive folder and accept a zip if that's easier.

Appreciate a short plan/owner and approximate delivery timeline.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
InfoSec Manager, Acme Data
Lena.Oritz@acmedata.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmedata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ handoff & control claim concordance

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask. We can definitely get a first-pass package to you by EOD Tuesday (9/7). Proposed plan below:

1) Today (9/4): we’ll run a CAIQ crosswalk extraction and populate a short-form template with the top 25 CSA controls you flagged. I’ve attached our quick bridge template (RBW-CAIQ-bridge-template.xlsx) to speed review.
2) 9/5–9/6: Kimberly and Marissa will collect representative artifacts for a sample of 8-10 high-risk controls, redact PII, and stage them in a shared Drive folder.
3) 9/7 AM: I’ll produce a PDF with claim summaries and links to artifacts; 9/7 EOD: final zip with the evidence index.

Owners:
- Kimberly Park: evidence collection and redaction (kimberly.park@redwood.com)
- Marissa Cole: artifact packaging and DocuSign/attestation coordination (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- Me: CAIQ crosswalk and final packaging (jordan.blake@redwood.com)

Can you confirm the list of priority controls (Lena: the three you mentioned — network segmentation, KMS/key rotation, tenant isolation — ok?), and whether your legal team requires signed attestations or just artifact delivery for now.

Sharing Drive link and DocuSign workflow once Marissa confirms.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ handoff & control claim concordance — evidence owners

Jordan / Marissa — starting evidence collation. Quick notes below — I’ll attach the index once I finish the first pass.

- Network segmentation (CSA-NET-03): owner is infra-apps team; I can pull architecture diagram + vpc ACL snippet + firewall rule dump (redacted).
- Key management (CSA-CRY-01): KMS rotation policy, KMS audit log sample (we’ll mask key IDs), HSM integration diagram.
- Tenant isolation / runtime separation (CSA-APP-09): container runtime config + tenant mapping table (redacted).

Attachment plan: I’ll create an evidence_index.csv and a zip (redwood-evidence-index_v1.zip) with representative artifacts. Expect first bundle by 9/06 15:00 PT.

Also quick call: we should align on the exact CSA control IDs that Acme wants documented. Jordan — can you confirm the list you used for the crosswalk?

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Park <tom.park@acmedata.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ handoff & control claim concordance

Jordan — procurement here. We’re tracking this for our vendor checklist and may need an executed attestation page as part of contracting. If Redwood can provide a short signature page attesting to the controls and the evidence package, please include it in the DocuSign packet. Our target is to complete vendor review by 9/10.

Thanks,
Tom Park
Senior Buyer, Acme Data
procurement@acmedata.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmedata.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@acmedata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ package: initial crosswalk + evidence bundle (draft)

Hi Lena / Tom — attaching our first-pass deliverables for your review:
- Acme-CAIQ-claims-draft.pdf (summary crosswalk and claim language)
- RBW-CAIQ-bridge-template.xlsx (filled with top controls)
- redwood-evidence-index_v1.zip (sample artifacts; redactions applied)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Acme-CAIQ-handoff
DocuSign (attestation page stub): https://app.docusign.com/Acme-CAIQ-SOW-12345

Notes:
- The PDF includes a concordance table tying each CSA ID to our internal control and a short evidence pointer.
- Kimberly’s index lists the artifact owner and a redaction flag per item.
- Marissa will open the DocuSign envelope once you confirm the attestation wording is acceptable.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the sample artifacts or flag any controls you want expanded (we can run additional log extracts for those). If you want the signed attestation, Marissa will send the DocuSign by EOD 9/7.

Thanks all — looping in Marissa for DocuSign ops.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acme-CAIQ-claims-draft.pdf, RBW-CAIQ-bridge-template.xlsx, redwood-evidence-index_v1.zip
